name: Ormoz lagoons 02.wav
description: There is a 1.5-kilometer-long educational trail that runs through the area of the nature reserve, which is equipped with information boards and observation points, and we were among the first to walk along it for you. At the entrance, a huge billboard awaited us in the parking lot, from which water buffaloes were staring at us. Those in the reserve ensure that the area does not become overgrown. But why water buffalo? They are very resistant to weather conditions, like to go into water and marshy areas and like a little more exotic food - they especially like aquatic plants! Since the area of the Ormo Lagoons is 55 ha, it would be impossible to maintain it without their help.
